evidence_classes.decision_hardware: Observed IBM SamplerV2 archives under decision-study/data/raw/.
evidence_classes.post_collection_policy_replay: New analysis of already-collected shots; not a new QPU job.

classical_fair_pools.csv.denominator: 32 replications; seed 20260909 + 1000 × fixture_index in code order. Same classical pools reused for p=1 and p=2 panels. Prefixes are nested prefixes of already acquired pools.
classical_fair_pools.csv.synthetic_elapsed_seconds: Plan value 10 s, not a measured classical runtime.
classical_fair_pools.csv.unit: fixture × QAOA-panel × prefix × Monte Carlo summary

ghz_jobs.csv.hellinger_vs_exact_ghz_baseline: Separate exact 000/111 split; not a substitute for Aer.
ghz_jobs.csv.hellinger_vs_sampled_aer_baseline: Hellinger agreement of computational-basis bitstring distributions versus each run's sampled Aer baseline; not quantum-state fidelity or entanglement certification.

job_level.csv.charged_usage_seconds: Reconciled IBM QPU charge for the job.
job_level.csv.client_dispatch_utc: Client created_utc in the raw archive; not IBM metrics.timestamps.created.
job_level.csv.missing: null if a provider timestamp was absent.

policy_level.csv.independent_strict_improvement: Recomputed from business utility versus greedy incumbent.
policy_level.csv.strict_improvement_field: Value returned by frozen apply_policy. P0 does not populate this field; do not treat missing as measured zero.

pub_level.csv.absolute_optimality_gap: exact_optimum - best_feasible_utility; null if no feasible shot (not observed).
pub_level.csv.feasible_shot_fraction: Feasible shots / 1024. Denominator is all shots, including infeasible.
pub_level.csv.optimal_hit_fraction: Shots equal to an exact optimum bitstring / 1024.
pub_level.csv.unit: one PUB = one fixture × depth inside one block

replay_adapter_compact.json / replay_ada.denominators: Six scenarios use all 72 pools; four substantive-change scenarios use only the first block's 12 pools. 480 pool/scenario combinations × 4 policies = 1,920 derived records. Not six-block specification-change replication.
replay_adapter_compact.json / replay_ada.missing: null selected when status is abstain/fallback without a candidate.
replay_adapter_compact.json / replay_ada.unit: derived policy record = one pool/scenario combination × one policy

simulation_fixture_replay.json.n: 24 fixtures × policies; 672 policy rows. Shared seed 4245 because S01–S24 IDs have equal length. Not hardware.
